# TakumiPay: Arbitrum Open House Singapore (Online Buildathon) submission

> TakumiPay bridges Paxos USDG to QRIS, one of the largest QR payment networks in Southeast Asia: USDG holders on Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain scan a QRIS code and spend USDG at Indonesian merchants, who receive rupiah. QRIS is reported to reach 44M+ merchants. Team: Planckify Labs. License: GPL-3.0.

Read README.md first. It has a fact sheet, a judging-criteria-to-evidence map, a list of known limitations, and commands that reproduce the on-chain claims.

## Key facts
- Smart contract: TakumiPay v2.1.0, UUPS proxy, Solidity 0.8.30, source at evm/src/TakumiPay.sol in the contract repo. Deployed on Arbitrum mainnet, Arbitrum testnet and Robinhood Chain testnet (README section "Deployed contracts").
- Arbitrum One (42161) proxy: 0xdE981573883294dfD35A7F0F399DB7e439E1f56B (USDG, USDC allowed). Configured, NOT smoke-tested.
- Arbitrum Sepolia (421614) proxy: 0x2469Bd87e809772f491af0E7847fbf7B62c388ae (USDC, USDG allowed). createTransaction and depositPoints exercised live.
- Robinhood Chain testnet (46630) proxy: 0x479B0843C3e0627f36551660506dEd5b349Fa968 (USDG allowed). createTransaction, depositPoints, processMerchantPayment exercised live.
- Not deployed on Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663), although the app lists it.
- USDG is the only stablecoin the app shows. Matching is by contract address.
- QRIS: 44M+ is the reported size of the QRIS network. TakumiPay's live merchant coverage today is a registered-merchant pilot; paying any QRIS merchant is the roadmap goal. See README section 5, item 7.
- Backend signer is a publicly known key; owner is a single EOA; no independent audit. See README section 5.

## Test merchant
- Registered QRIS test merchant: GTron, SELONG, NMID ID1024347475146, PAN 936009143669405532. Image: assets/test-qris-gtron-selong.jpeg. It is a real shop's public sticker: do not pay it with a normal bank or e-wallet app; use TakumiPay on testnet. Only registered merchants resolve today.
